# Membership

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Membership`](gmeow-Membership.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Membership>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

The reified relationship by which an agent is a member of an organization, optionally playing a role over a period of time.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)
